title: Ultra-Low-Loss Silicon Nitride on Sapphire for Broad-Transparency Nonlinear and Quantum Photonics
summary: The field of photonic integrated circuits (PIC) has flourished in the past two decades, fueling numerous cutting-edge applications across sensing, networking, data interconnect, and quantum information processing. As a guiding material for PIC, Si$_3$N$_4$ has seen extensive use for its ultra-low loss, broad transparency, and diversity in implementation across both thin and thick films.
